dev.create.agreementAccepted: I have fully read and agree to the OTools Developer Agreement
dev.create.agreement1P1: This agreement applies to all actions you take while creating, binding, debugging, packaging, and publishing plugins in OTools Dev.
dev.create.agreement1P2: Once you agree and create a plugin, the system will write plugin metadata to your local filesystem and continue performing related actions when you actively enable debugging or packaging.
dev.create.agreement2P1: You must ensure that packid, name, icon, screenshots, summary, version, download URL, and other metadata are truthful, accurate, and complete, and must not impersonate official brands, third-party brands, or other developers.
dev.create.agreement2P2: You confirm that you have lawful rights to use the plugin code, assets, dependencies, and packaged artifacts, and you must not upload, distribute, or reference content that infringes copyrights, trademarks, patents, portrait rights, or other legitimate rights.
dev.create.agreement3P1: Plugins must not contain malicious code, backdoors, viruses, trojans, ransomware logic, mining scripts, undisclosed data collection, remote control capabilities, or other harmful content.
dev.create.agreement3P2: Plugins must not be used for illegal purposes, bypass system permissions, attack third-party services, steal account information, scrape restricted data at scale, or induce high-risk actions.
dev.create.agreement4P1: Icons and screenshots must use stable https image URLs. Displayed content must match actual functionality and must not use misleading promotion, fake ratings, fake official badges, or unrelated assets.
dev.create.agreement4P2: If you provide download URLs, descriptions, changelogs, or preview images, they must be accessible, verifiable, and consistent with the delivered plugin version.
dev.create.agreement5P1: Before binding a development directory, ensure it is under your control and contains at least plugin.json. After debugging is enabled, OTools may directly load the local entry from that directory, so you are responsible for stability and security.
dev.create.agreement5P2: If changes to directory contents, entry files, or resource paths cause plugin failures, white screens, unavailable features, or affect the main application, you bear the responsibility.
dev.create.agreement6P1: Packaging generates a plugin package based on current metadata and the bound directory. If contents, logo.png, plugin.json, icon, screenshots, or download URLs do not meet requirements, packaging or publishing may be refused.
dev.create.agreement6P2: When publishing a new version, you must provide the version number, changelog, and download URL, and maintain history, rollback strategy, and dependency compatibility yourself.
dev.create.agreement7P1: For plugins that violate this agreement, introduce security risks, involve infringement disputes, false promotion, or affect platform stability, OTools may refuse loading, stop displaying them, remove records, take versions offline, or terminate related capabilities without compensation.
dev.create.agreement7P2: You are solely responsible for user losses, third-party claims, administrative penalties, litigation, or system damage caused by your plugin, assets, download URLs, or related conduct.
dev.create.agreement8P1: Checking the agreement means that you understand and accept all terms and are willing to assume all responsibilities related to plugin development, distribution, and maintenance.
dev.create.agreement8P2: If you do not agree with any term of this agreement, do not continue creating, debugging, packaging, or publishing plugins.
